name: Air Land And Sea
summary: Two-player card duel for control of three theaters to reach 12 victory points.
rules_text: Place Air, Land, Sea boards in a row. Shuffle 18 battle cards, deal 6 face-down to each player as hand. Shuffle 2 supreme commander cards, deal one to each; red goes first each battle. A battle: players alternate taking one action: Deploy a card face-up from hand to its matching theater on your side, covering any cards already there and immediately resolving its instant or ongoing ability, Improvise a card face-down to any theater as strength 2 with no ability, or Withdraw and concede the battle. Covered cards cannot be flipped but keep abilities and can move. Abilities may flip, move, draw, or modify strength, and may affect adjacent theaters. After both play 6 cards or one withdraws, total strength per theater per side; who has higher sum controls it. Most theaters controlled wins the battle. Score VPs based on how many cards opponent still held when battle ended; withdrawing gives opponent fewer VPs. First to 12 VPs wins the match.
rating_reason: Known 2p bluffing card battle, three theaters, perfect fit
